name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward with one foot, planting your full foot firmly on the floor.
Bend both knees to lower your hips until your rear knee approaches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to push back to standing and alternate legs.
tips: Give your feet enough sideways clearance to keep your balance.
Keep your torso upright and track your front knee in line with your toes.
